Hey Alex & Samira,

Thanks again for your time earlier today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next step so we keep momentum: 

- Key goals you mentioned: reduce inference latency on query-time models, cut per-token cost for high-concurrency endpoints, and integrate inference into an internal multi-tenant service.
- Current constraints: procurement window in Q4, security questionnaire underway, and a hard requirement for private VPC option for PII-handling routes.

Recommended next step: 60-minute technical deep dive with our infra lead (Jonas) and solution architect (Marcus) to walk through: deployment topologies (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), KV cache strategies for your traffic patterns, and a short perf/cost projection with sample workload.

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Tue Aug 25, 10:30–11:30
- Tue Aug 25, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Aug 26, 09:00–10:00

We had one cancelation on a recent run-through where the customer didn’t join last-minute, so I’d like to tighten confirmation here. Can you confirm the best slot by EOD tomorrow (Aug 24)? If we don’t hear back, we’ll hold the 10:30 slot for you but will release it by 8:30 AM Tue.

Also attaching the discovery notes and a short XLS with the metrics you shared so Jonas can pre-load examples. If you have any additional stakeholders who should join (security, infra, SRE), please flag them now.

Thanks — Tessa
